title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I'm out with El Condor Pasa, when…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué bonito! Do my eyes deceive me or are those Umamusume plushies?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: We could line them up with all my trophies! Think how awesome it'd be to sit down with a plate of nachos and check 'em all out!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Claw machines are so fun! They're a hella exciting challenge!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: But the claw never does what I tell it to… The last time I tried, my wallet kept getting lighter, like my money was flying away…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Then when I told Grass about it, all she did was lecture me about being more responsible. I'd rather not have a repeat of that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa trembles a little as the memory of Grass's reprimands resurfaces.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you win one for me instead!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll avenge your poor wallet!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh, that's my trainer! I'll be waiting for my plushie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
